parts:
On 04/22/2014 04:50 PM, Burcu Demiray wrote:
> would really appreciate it if you could take a look at the doc attached
> and see my model and output! Thank you!

What we need to see is your data. The 'robust' test statistics can deal
with excess kurtosis, but not with all sorts of non-normality (eg
extreme skewness). If your scaled chi-square test statistic goes up (a
lot), the correction simply failed. (Do you get the same problem with
estimator="MLR"?)

If you want me to further investigate this, I need your full R-script
and dataset.

Yves.
